openPosition.metaDescription: Gimetry Studio is hiring a freelance 3D Designer & Animator to craft stunning visuals and motion for brands, packaging, and digital experiences. Remote, flexible, and creatively fulfilling.

children.text: We’re storytellers, designers, inventors and thinkers. With an active roster of ongoing client work, and a whole bunch of new projects bursting through the door, we’re now looking for a driven, enthusiastic, wildly talented designer to be a part of our exciting next steps.
Gimetry Studio is looking for a

to join our extended creative team. This is a freelance role with the potential for long-term collaboration. You’ll work closely with our branding, web, and product teams to bring ideas to life through stunning visuals and motion.
Designing and animating 3D visuals for a range of industries, from wellness and tech to consumer products and AI
Creating photorealistic and stylized 3D renders for packaging, environments, campaigns, and product launches
Animating scenes for web, social, and presentations, from subtle loops to bold brand statements
Collaborating with brand strategists, designers, and motion artists to tell stories through design
Helping us prototype faster and build more dynamic, expressive creative work

bring them to life with animation
